b'# tinydl

A tiny command-line utility to download content from a URL.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl [OPTIONS] URL
```

## Options

- `URL`: what to download
- `-o`, `--output`: file to write (default: stdout)
- `-q`, `--quiet`: no progress output
'
